observations.behavior: Adds a new function `seriesUnit` to resolve a single unit from an array of series, returning undefined if units disagree; also adds `capReducers` to deduplicate and limit reducers to 6.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent mislabeling of metric values when series have mixed units, potentially improving chart readability and preventing user confusion.

observations.behavior: Adds a new function `safeColorToken` to validate and sanitize color tokens, falling back to a default if the token contains potentially dangerous characters.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent potential XSS or style injection attacks by sanitizing user input before it is used in CSS class names.
